Decisions recorded against [artifact:prj-b98fe8c3bc.microarchitecture.a1]:
(1) merge(old,data,strb) is built as a byte mask from a generate loop, (old & ~mask) | (data & mask). The behaviour is the same; the change avoids variable-index loop code that could raise lint WIDTH warnings.
(2) aw_addr_q, w_data_q and w_strb_q are not reset, as section 2 specifies. Their use is gated by the reset held flags.
(3) The failure-path testbench (axi4_lite_regs_tb_fail.v) in the verification-plan table is not delivered. simulator.run compiles every testbench file together, so a second top would conflict. That item stays open for a later task.
(4) The formal properties live in the RTL under `ifdef FORMAL`, as section 7 describes. Lint and synthesis do not define FORMAL.

Assumptions about the platform:
- The testbench avoids `timescale and uses only plain Verilog, so it should run under Icarus or Verilator --binary. It assumes the simulator accepts $error, as the card requires.
- The .sby uses [tasks] prove/cover. If formal.cover runs the file without selecting the cover task, both tasks run.
